content.title: Rory McIlroy's huge net worth now and 4am texts which annoyed wife Erica
content.text: Rory McIlroy is in the hunt for his second Green Jacket at the Masters tonightGolf star Rory McIlroy tees off for his final round at The Masters this evening and he's in with a great shout of retaining the coveted Green Jacket.Northern Ireland's McIlroy secured the blazer last year after winning a dramatic play-off with pal Justin Rose at Augusta.He's doing in the hard way again at the world-famous course, having seen his six-shot lead at the halfway point evaporate.He will tee off alongside American Cameron Young tonight, tied for the lead at 11-under ahead of the final round.If he were to walk away with a win, the huge prize money would go someway to help boost his incredible net worth.McIlroy's staggering net worth currently stands at an estimated £186million ($250m).We use your sign-up to provide content in ways you've consented to and improve our understanding of you. This may include adverts from us and third parties based on our knowledge of you. More infoHis fortune is a reflection of nearly two decades of sustained brilliance at the very summit of professional golf.Unlike numerous professional sports where income is determined by a fixed salary or a set season, golf presents an unlimited earning potential for those capable of delivering consistently on the grandest stages.McIlroy's £186m fortune has been constructed on a bedrock of substantial tournament winnings (including five majors), landmark endorsement deals and a particularly astute approach to venture capital.His partnership with Nike alone has netted him hundreds of millions over the past decade. When you take into account his equipment deal with TaylorMade and prestigious sponsorships with brands such as Omega and UnitedHealth Group, his annual earnings frequently eclipse those of virtually every other athlete on the planet.Furthermore, he has demonstrated considerable business acumen through his firm, Symphony Ventures, where he has acquired stakes in high-growth companies such as Whoop and Troon Golf, ensuring his net worth continues to grow even during periods away from the tour.Off the fairway, McIlroy is married to Erica Stoll and the pair share a daughter together, Poppy.The golfer filed for divorce in 2024 but the couple made a U-turn a month later. “There have been rumours about my personal life recently, which is unfortunate," McIlroy said at the time. "Responding to each rumour is a fool’s game."Over the past weeks, Erica and I have realised that our best future was as a family together. Thankfully, we have resolved our differences and look forward to a new beginning.”Stoll will be Augusta this evening to watch her husband attempt to retain his crown. One person who won't be there is Tiger Woods, who has recently been involved in controversy, having been arrested and charged with driving under the influence.McIlroy and Woods are close, having competed against each other for years. "I'm drawn to him, yeah," McIlroy said of Woods in 2017. "He's an intriguing character because you could spend two hours in his company and see four different sides to him. He's thoughtful. He's smart. He can't sleep, so that's all he does - he reads stuff and educates himself on everything."Alan Shipnuck's biography, Rory: The Heartache and Triumph of Golf's Most Human Superstar, claims Woods would often text his friend in the early hours of the morning while he was at the gym - something which it is said particularly irks his wife."He struggles to sleep, which I think is an effect of over-training, so I tell him to calm down sometimes," McIlroy said of Woods in 2017, according to Shipnuck's book, via the Daily Mail."He'd be texting me at four o'clock in the morning: 'Up lifting. What are you doing?' Erica actually got p****d off with it. He was texting me in the middle of the night, and I was like, 'Tiger is in the gym.'"
